subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite the linked fix on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or keep this issue parked until a replacement PR owns the fix?
rationale: The bug is paired with an open candidate PR, but the remaining decision crosses session-state, Gateway protocol, and proof expectations that automation should not settle from the issue alone.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the active-run recovery intent while using the current filtered session-run contracts and live proof.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update the existing branch and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another merge review.

options.title: Keep parked until replacement
options.body: If a newer proof-positive PR becomes the safe fix path, this issue can remain linked to that canonical replacement instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the active-run recovery intent while using the current filtered session-run contracts and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main history signal for the refactored UI/Gateway code that a replacement would touch.
